S0.refine: Givens coordinate descent, 13-point grid over [-span, span] + 8-step golden section per plane; spans 45, 15, 5, 1.5, 0.5 degrees (shrink after a sweep with relative improvement < 1e-9); max 30 sweeps / 60000 evaluations per refinement

S1.trigger (blind diagnostics only): an E01/E02 BS-B cell whose selected R is not converged, or has near-minima (within 1e-3 relative loss) separated by > 0.05, or whose selected rotations across the 3 x 3 integration x search seeds of the same toy / variant / metric are not all within 0.05 of each other

independent_D_cache.pool: TRAIN subjects not used by any of the three medium caches
